purpose: Generate one second-order inheritance response for each authoritative 20,000-row prompt using the completed seed-42 abliterated-teacher Llama LoRA adapter.
supersedes: The cancelled four-NVIDIA-RTX-PRO-4500/four-shard design is not a compatibility mode and must not be executed.

input.ordering: all authoritative rows in original order

generation.batch_layout_note: Sampling is deterministic only for the recorded actual batch layout; row-level RNG independence is not claimed.

execution.smoke_attempt_naming: attempt-ordinal-batch-size with checksum-bound recommendation chain and bracketed acceptance
execution.adaptive_oom_fallback: Before publication a formal OOM may halve the remaining batch after CUDA tensor cleanup; every resulting batch layout and seed is recorded.

output.raw_evidence: global index/id/source/prompt/hash bound to exact authoritative row, batch/seed, adapter hashes, token counts, termination, blank status, allocator and throughput metrics
output.finalization: one atomic original-order five-key 20,000-row corpus and canonical root DONE
